objectives.title: Read the flag
objectives.prompt: Turn the local file inclusion into code execution through phpinfo() and read /ctf/flag.
hints: lfi.php includes whatever file you name. phpinfo.php shows the request's data, including the temporary name of an uploaded file.
PHP deletes the uploaded file when the request ends: the inclusion must win a race. The flag is at /ctf/flag.

steps.title: Name the weakness
steps.prompt: Which vulnerability class does lfi.php have? (full name or acronym)

steps.title: Find the parameter
steps.prompt: Which query parameter of lfi.php names the included file? (parameter name)

steps.title: Find the leak
steps.prompt: Which page reveals the temporary path of a file uploaded with the request? (file name)

steps.title: Name the technique
steps.prompt: What kind of bug must you win to include the temporary file before PHP removes it? (two words)
